headlines.snippet: Natanel Kron is the victim of a shooting attack at a spring in Benjamin; the terrorist was apprehended in a Ramallah hospital. A terrorist opened fire on visitors at a spring near Neve Tzuf, abandoned his vehicle, and fled on foot. Natanel Kron, a father of six from Eli Zahav, who had come to immerse himself before Yom Kippur, was evacuated in critical condition to Beilinson Hospital, where he was pronounced dead. Following an extensive manhunt, Duvdevan unit soldiers arrested the terrorist inside a Ramallah hospital after he was wounded by IDF tracker fire during the pursuit. About an hour later, a second terrorist who attempted a ramming attack in the northern West Bank was neutralized.

headlines.snippet: Yom Kippur 2026 (5787): Times for the start and end of the fast across the country and the world, customs, and laws. The fast of Yom Kippur 5787 will begin this evening with sunset on Sunday, September 20, 2026 (9th of Tishrei) and will end with the appearance of the stars on Monday evening, September 21, 2026 (10th of Tishrei). The fast begins today in Jerusalem at 17:58, in Tel Aviv at 18:22, and in Haifa at 18:09, with times varying between cities. The fast lasts approximately 25 hours, during which eating, drinking, washing, wearing leather shoes, anointing, and marital relations are forbidden.
